However, in their current form, these data are very general and can only be used to a certain degree to inform programmatic decisions. Fortunately, all these data are from the American Community Survey— therefore, a more detailed analyses can be completed to complement the ResStock data. 23 This report is available at no cost from NREL at www.nrel.gov/publications.
